meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读取数据库和配置，把当前渠道分为已接线、已配置未接线、未配置三类；然后用命令把消息渠道（如 Telegram、Slack、WhatsApp）连接到指定的代理组，并设置会话模式、隔离级别和触发方式，最后给出配置摘要。
howto.when: 在添加新消息渠道后、初始设置期间，或想重新配置渠道与代理组的连接时触发。若实例尚无 owner，会先建议运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 查一下当前哪些渠道已接线、哪些没接
say.note: 展示渠道分类和用户权限

say.text: 把 Slack 渠道改为按名称模式触发，模式是 (?i)^@bot\b
say.note: 修改该接线的 engage 模式

howto.what_en: Claude reads the DB/config, classifies channels as wired/unwired/not-configured, wires channels to agent groups, sets session mode/isolation/trigger, and shows a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers after adding a channel, during initial setup, or when reconfiguring channel-group wiring. If no owner exists, it suggests /init-first-agent first.

say_en.text: Wire Telegram group 12345 to agent group A with agent-shared session mode.
say_en.note: Creates wiring and updates the DB.

say_en.text: Show which channels are wired and which are not.
say_en.note: Displays channel categories and user roles.

say_en.text: Change Slack wiring to pattern mode with pattern (?i)^@bot\b.
say_en.note: Updates the engage mode for that wiring.
